title: instanceof pattern
description: Use instanceof with pattern matching to identify the type of an Object. Given an Object that can be a String, Integer or Double, print its type and value without doing manual casting.
hints: instanceof with pattern: if (obj instanceof String s) { ... } - the variable 's' is already the casted String
You no longer need: (String) obj - pattern matching does it automatically
You can use chained else-if or switch to test several types
solutionExplanation: instanceof with pattern matching allows verifying the type and assigning the variable in a single step. No manual casting like (String) obj is needed. The pattern variable already has the correct type inside the if block.
expectedOutput:
Text: Hola mundo
Integer: 42
Decimal: 3.14
Unknown type

title: switch with patterns
description: Create a method that receives an Object and uses switch with pattern matching to process different types: String (print length), Integer (print if it is even or odd), Double (print with 2 decimal places). For other types, print "Not supported".
hints: switch (obj) { case String s -> ..., case Integer i -> ..., ... }
In Java 21+, switch with patterns replaces chained instanceof
String.format("%.2f", d) formats a double to 2 decimal places
solutionExplanation: The switch with pattern matching in Java 21+ allows matching against types without casting. Each case assigns a variable with the correct type. The switch returns a value that is assigned to resultado.
expectedOutput:
Text of 7 characters
Even integer: 10
Odd integer: 7
Decimal: 2.72
Not supported

title: Sealed + pattern
description: Create a sealed hierarchy: seal the Forma interface allowing only Ciculo, Rectangulo and Triangulo to implement it. Each shape has an area() method. Use an exhaustive switch with patterns to calculate the area of each shape without using instanceof.
hints: interface Forma permits Ciculo, Rectangulo, Triangulo {} seals the interface
Each implementation must be final (records are final by default)
The switch is exhaustive because the interface is sealed: you don't need default
solutionExplanation: The sealed interface with 'permits' restricts the implementations to Ciculo, Rectangulo and Triangulo. This allows the switch to be exhaustive: the compiler knows all possible types and does not require a default case. Each record implements area() and the switch delegates to the corresponding method.
expectedOutput:
Ciculo[radio=5.0] -> Area: 78.54
Rectangulo[base=4.0, altura=6.0] -> Area: 24.00
Triangulo[base=3.0, altura=8.0] -> Area: 12.00
